timeline.summary: Shareholders via postal ballot (remote e-voting) approved Mr. Shigeki Iwama’s re-appointment as CMO & CEO (DIN: 0010075458) and remuneration on May 1, 2026, with 100% promoter and 99.84% public votes.
Honda India Power Products announced postal ballot voting results on 1 May 2026 approving executive re-appointments.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹264.53 Cr (-1.5% YoY), net profit ₹26.92 Cr (-25.6% YoY).
